Create #venue section with The Old Gallery, Warsaw, believable address, travel tips, complete accessibility notes and parking/public transport notes. Select tier buttons should launch checkout mock modal. Create newsletter section with email input and submit, inline email validation and a signup toast.

Footer needs ARTIFACT logo, event credits, social-style links, copyright, and exact small note “Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase.”
